gloss_en: son (ben) — the male child/offspring in relation to a father, used as the kabbalistic aspect of the lower, receiving level (the 'half utterance' of the small son echoing the father's complete utterance, lower Eden/lower Wisdom), and homiletically expounded (e.g., 'Yitzchak ben Avraham', 'yashuv benekha') as alluding to teshuvah; not to be confused with homographic readings such as בֵּין 'between'
